answer: Darky here: the network watches how graders vote together. Every epoch it compares each pair of graders over their last 50 shared seats; any pair that agrees over 95% of the time while going against the rest of the panel gets their votes merged into one. Clone rings run like water through karst, out of sight, but they leave a channel you can trace. Building 40 copies is cheap timber, yet they still cast one vote, so the attacker carries 40 bonds of ferrous dead weight for one voice.
